whenToUse: All text: Heading (level and size decoupled), Text, Lead, Code, Blockquote, Numeric, Prose.
Following the data-font axis instead of hard-coded fonts.
avoidWhen: Raw font-family or arbitrary font sizes — use the type scale tokens.
a11y: Choose heading level by outline, size by design; never skip levels.
Use Numeric/tabular digits for figures in tables.
